acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI SEO services for electricians can vary widely based on the scope of work, the provider's expertise, and the desired outcomes. Factors influencing cost include the initial audit, keyword research intensity, content creation needs, local SEO optimization, and ongoing maintenance. While some providers offer basic packages, more comprehensive strategies involving advanced AI tools and continuous optimization will typically incur higher costs. It's advisable to get a tailored quote after a thorough assessment of your business needs.
